question: What is the studio policy for reserve advance

metadata.reference_answer: A booking may be cancelled without prior notice if the provided information is incorrect or if the rules are violated.

question: What is the studio policy for booking cancel invalid info

metadata.reference_answer: One booking can include a maximum of 3 sessions.

question: What is the studio policy for how many sessions

metadata.reference_answer: A booking cannot be transferred to another person.

question: What is the studio policy for transfer booking

metadata.reference_answer: One booking can include up to 3 sessions. Payment must be made immediately after booking; if it is not paid within 10 minutes, the booking is cancelled and a new booking is required.

question: What is the studio policy for booking session and payment

metadata.reference_answer:
Booking steps:
•    Select the required service or zone.
•    Choose a date and time.
•    Fill in the user information.
•    Review the booking details.
•    Pay by bank transfer.
•    Upload the payment slip.

question: What is the studio policy for how reservation

metadata.reference_answer: Cancellations must be made at least 1 hour in advance.

question: What is the studio policy for cancellation advance

metadata.reference_answer: Check-in is available up to 30 minutes before the reserved time slot, and users must check in before the slot begins.

question: What is the studio policy for how early can check

metadata.reference_answer: If users fail to check in before the reserved time slot begins, the booking will be automatically cancelled with no refund.

question: What is the studio policy for late check in

metadata.reference_answer: Once a booking is confirmed, it cannot be edited. To make changes, users must cancel by email at least 1 hour before the reserved time, make a new booking, and attach the previous payment slip.

question: What is the studio policy for change booking
